title: Ask the Shop Worker
can_do: 在走失演练中向可识别的工作人员说明找不到家长、说出名字并留在安全地点。

conversation_move.label: ask an identifiable safe adult for help

trigger: Mom starts a calm home rehearsal and plays a shop worker wearing a visible name badge.
stretch_response: My name is Leo. Can you help me, please?
repair_response: I need help finding my mom. I will stay here.
setting: A calm pretend shop-worker rehearsal at home.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Let's practice. Pretend I am a shop worker with a name badge.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Excuse me. I can't find my mom.

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: You came to a worker. What is your name?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: My name is Leo. Can you help me, please?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Yes. Stay with me while I call for your mom.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Okay. I will stay here with you.

replay_cards.title: Ask a security officer
replay_cards.change: Dad wears a pretend security badge
replay_cards.challenge: Say the parent is missing, give the child's first name, and stay while the officer gets help

replay_cards.title: Ask a parent with children
replay_cards.change: No worker is visible, but Mom plays a parent caring for children
replay_cards.challenge: Ask that adult for help, do not leave the public area, and wait while the adult contacts staff

parent_support: Practice calmly; never hide from the child or stage a frightening real separation.
Teach identifiable helpers such as a store employee, security officer, police officer, or parent with children; the child must not leave for a parking lot.
